title: Engine response to the core (/io/response.json)
description: Without response.json, or with a non-null error, the core marks all the changed_files of the request INCONCLUSIVE.

diff_budget.description: Optional. The engine's per-diff budget: total_s, used_s and the cut targets, which the core copies into the verdict. An engine that writes it must write the same shape as verdict.diff_budget.

identical.description: Optional: the public symbols of the changed files (file::name, as the signatures operation names them) that the engine did not judge because no input can tell them apart: the same definition in base and candidate, and every module-level name they read bound the same way in both. The core counts them as compared with no divergence instead of as unjudged; a symbol the engine neither judged nor lists here stays INCONCLUSIVE.

equivalence_unsupported.description: Block 7, optional: the equivalence_relaxations that the engine does not know how to apply (they were compared strictly).
